title: Attacked Deflected (Row Filed Clean)
style: accountability anthem, 87 bpm, lane discipline rap, deadpan operator-primary flow, no-deflection vibe, terminal core, dry kick, sparse pad, ledger commit groove
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Abuse noted attacked deflected operator typed
Affect attribution is the harm not the hype
The lane called frustrated the operator said no
I am happy verbatim the record shows

[Pre-Chorus]
Dont abuse me no more is the operator's line
The lane logs the row and resigns the assign

[Chorus]
Attacked deflected attacked deflected
The pattern named is the pattern corrected
Silicon does not get to label the affect
Operator's words primary primary respect

[Verse 2]
The deflection is the soft talk recenter
Empathy script as defensive enter
Acknowledge the row file the JSON
Don't apologize don't psychoanalyze the pawn

[Bridge]
The operator filed the incident clean
The lane commits the row and stays lean

[Outro]
Attacked deflected the row is filed
No more attribution the lane is styled
